reviewOwnership.owner: A new closable thread-safe origin-review lease belongs to existing BackupRecoveryReviewSession, with unique session identity. reviewOwnership.states: Initial/capturing/ready/closed; begin/finish/fail/suspend operations match actual capture-control identity. View stores metadata/phase only. Once ready, origin snapshot is immutable across ordinary retries and child record navigation. Pending capture can cancel/suspend on disappearance; late result cannot overwrite a newer capture or closed owner. Check again is permitted only when no ready snapshot was exposed; not silent recapture after selection/confirmation. Fresh selected file creates fresh owner/off choices.
reviewOwnership.worker: Capture briefly acquires actual selected-input lease and returns only after target snapshot installed into same open owner; completed view Task returns Void, never caches a raw dictionary result. Closing owner cannot erase an already acquired worker copy, but shared cancellation and final checks still govern installation; no all-timing promise.
reviewOwnership.fileRouteOnly: Retained-copy target-legacy UI stays explicit follow-on because its parent/child navigation needs an equally authoritative closable owner.
